claim: For Db2, MariaDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL, io2 Block Express storage ranges from 100–65,536 GiB with 1,000–256,000 IOPS, and the table lists a maximum throughput of 16,000 MiB/s.
question: What storage size, IOPS and throughput ranges does io2 Block Express offer for RDS for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and Db2?

values.spoken: one hundred to sixty-five thousand five hundred thirty-six gibibytes
one thousand to two hundred fifty-six thousand IOPS

qualifiers.scope: per storage volume (io2 Block Express; Db2, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
qualifiers.condition: the DB instance class can impose lower limits; the comparison table on the same page says throughput scales up to 4,000 MB/s

note: The io2 table states 16,000 MiB/s maximum throughput, while the comparison table and the constraint list on the same page say 4,000 MiB/s (MB/s). Record as the source states; writers should prefer the 256,000 IOPS value and avoid the throughput figure in questions.
